data.subject: Local Ledger: PCYO and FIP
data.body:
Hi,

Bard Associates' most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCYO and FIP.

On August 25, 2026, PCYO disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276720/000110465926100607/pcyo-20260824x8k.htm).

Local Ledger is an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. I can send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot for your team. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
